name: Kdenlive
title: Kdenlive: free Adobe Premiere Pro alternative
hook: Premiere Pro charges you twenty three bucks a month to edit your videos. This app does it for free.

features.say: A flexible timeline with multicam editing, markers, and automatic backups.
Grade your color with LUTs and scopes, then add hundreds of effects with keyframes.
It makes subtitles with automatic transcription, and you can style them.

caption:
Premiere Pro costs $22.99/month to edit videos. Kdenlive does it for free 🎬

✅ Flexible timeline with multicam editing, markers and automatic backups
✅ Color grading with LUTs, scopes and hundreds of effects with keyframes
✅ Subtitles with automatic transcription, plus titles and text
✅ No subscription, no trial, free to download

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ On Mac there are separate Apple Silicon and Intel downloads (macOS 13 or newer). Adobe's $22.99/month is the Premiere-only plan, billed monthly on an annual plan

Comment "CUT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
